note: Items only the Mac offers so far, read beside setup-catalog.json (the contract Windows embeds as is). An item moves into setup-catalog.json once Windows has it. opencode is OpenCode 2 (@opencode/cli); an OpenCode 1 below 2.0.0 reads out of date and is replaced (npm uninstall -g opencode-ai first, SetupCatalog.npmReplaces). hermes is Hermes Agent (Nous Research): its official installer brings its own uv and Python, needs git, and is run with --skip-setup (SetupCatalog.scriptArguments) so the app offers the sign-in itself.
